message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates that fall on a weekday will give you an extra day off, and if they fall on a weekend you’ll still get the weekend itself as a “long” break):

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? |
|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sun | Yes (already a weekend) |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 | Mon | Yes |
| Louis Riel Day (Manitoba) | Feb 20 | Mon | Yes |
| St. Patrick’s Day (Newfoundland & Labrador) | Mar 17 | Wed | Yes |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Fri | Yes |
| Easter Monday (Ontario, Quebec, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) | Apr 10 | Mon | Yes |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Mon | Yes |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Tue | Yes |
| Civic Holiday (most provinces) | Aug 7 | Mon | Yes |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Mon | Yes |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 | Mon | Yes |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Mon | Yes |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Mon | Yes |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tue | Yes |

**Quick notes:**

- **Family Day** is observed in Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Ontario on the third Monday in February (Feb 20, 2023).  
- **Louis Riel Day** is observed in Manitoba on the same day (Feb 20, 2023).  
- **St. Patrick’s Day** is a statutory holiday in Newfoundland & Labrador on March 17, 2023.  
- **Easter Monday** is a statutory holiday in Ontario, Quebec, New Brunswick, and Prince Edward Island on April 10, 2023.  
- **Civic Holiday** is observed in most provinces on the first Monday in August (Aug 7, 2023).  

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app!
